source_instruction: i am looking for resealable snak club antioxidant trail mix. 5.5oz packs of six.
query: Ugh, you won’t believe the chaos I ran into on the walk over here! A group of baby ducks somehow waddled off the nearby park path and straight into the bike lane, holding up a whole line of commuters who were all too charmed to shoo them away. I stopped to help the park ranger herd them back to their mom by the pond, and one tiny fuzzy duckling even hopped onto my sneaker for two whole seconds before waddling after its siblings, leaving a little damp webbed footprint right on the toe cap. I’m still grinning about it, honestly, it made my whole otherwise boring errand run feel like a silly little surprise. Hey, I’m browsing the dried fruits & raisins section right now and could use your help tracking something down. I need a pack that comes with a built-in moisture-wicking packet, y’know, so the fruit doesn’t go soggy after I open it? Can you grab that one for me, the size I always get? I don’t want it to cost too much, so just make sure it’s not wildly expensive, yeah?
